== Notes ==
* Only the standard adrenaline gain from making an attack is doubled, not any other effects that generate adrenaline, even if they are part of the attack (such as [[Enraged Smash]] or [[Thrill of Victory]]).
* Stacks additively with [[Dark Fury]] (for a total of 3 adrenaline per hit) or [[Mark of Fury]] (2-5 adrenaline per hit depending on rank). Does not stack with [["For Great Justice!"]], [[Focused Anger]], or [[Infuriating Heat]].
* [[Hero]]es will cast Weapon of Fury on [[attacking]] allies with priority to those with enhanced attack-rating and/or striking multiple foes.
